messages:
Anna Chen: Heads-up — I'm drafting the release notes for the next docs deploy. Focus areas: routing fallback behavior, embed-stream tweaks, and the Dedicated capacity docs. I'll push a PR later today with a short 'Before you upgrade' section. /cc @Mike Park
Mike Park: Thanks Anna. Can you include a concise SDK migration snippet? #3421 renamed a couple params and we should show old vs new usage (2–3 lines).
Anna Chen: Yep — plan to add a small diff example and a quick one-liner CLI upgrade note. Also adding a checklist in the PR description for link fixes and snippet updates.
Lucy Gomez: Heads up — anchorcheck found a few broken anchors in /docs/sdk/python/generation after the recent folder rename. I can run a sweep once the PR is created and patch the 404s.
Anna Chen: Perfect. Checklist in PR: 1) migration blurb w/ snippet, 2) run anchorcheck + fix 404s, 3) update examples that use `client.embed_streaming`, 4) add 'known issues' entry about intermittent duplicate chunks.
Mike Park: For the known issues wording, can we avoid alarmist phrasing? Suggest: 'Intermittent duplicate chunks may appear when using embed streaming with very small batch sizes.' Add workaround: 'Increase batch_size or set stream_chunk_size to 512.'
Anna Chen: Nice — will copy that wording verbatim. Also adding a tiny code example for the workaround: `client.embeddings(..., batch_size=128)` in the note.
Lucy Gomez: There's an old example in /examples/embed-batching.md that references the removed `embed_stream_v1` path — I'll update it and remove the redirect.
docs-bot: anchorcheck report attached: 5 broken links in docs/sdk, 1 orphan example in examples/old-embed, 2 missing code blocks in migration guides.
Anna Chen: Thanks bot. I'll attach the anchorcheck output to the PR so reviewers can see the list.
Mike Park: Also, small ask — can we add a one-line whatsnew blurb for the site top? Something crisp for marketing copy.
Anna Chen: Draft thought: 'Adaptive routing for cost-aware fallbacks and refined embed streaming for more consistent small-batch behavior.' Mike — can you tighten to a single sentence good for a banner?
Mike Park: Drafted: 'Improved routing controls for more predictable latency and lower serving costs; embed streaming refined for fewer duplicate chunks in small batches.'
Lucy Gomez: LGTM. I'll do a final proofread and run anchorcheck after PR opens. ETA: later today.
Anna Chen: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987 — PR description includes the checklist, anchorcheck output, and the migration snippet. Please review when you can.
Mike Park: Reviewing now — will leave inline comments for the SDK snippet and the whatsnew blurb.
Lucy Gomez: Anchorcheck run complete. Pushed a tiny fix for two anchors and the 404 redirect.
Anna Chen: Thanks — merging to release branch after Mike's signoff. Planning deploy tomorrow morning. :rocket:
